env.label: shared CI VM - noisy, for relative comparison
env.build: CMake Release, cmake version 4.5.0, GitHub-hosted macOS runner (macos26 20261117.0516.1)
env.build_facts: optimized, stdio: macOS libc, tblog: static library

config.lost_definition: acknowledged (last index whose logging call returned, per thread) minus the longest prefix 1..k of that thread found whole in the log file

scenarios.segv_main: null-pointer store on the logging thread after N lines
scenarios.segv_other_thread: 4 threads log continuously; a 5th thread does a null-pointer store after a random delay
scenarios.abort: abort() on the logging thread after N lines
scenarios.assert: failed assert() (NDEBUG undefined) on the logging thread after N lines
scenarios.uncaught_exception: throw with no handler (std::terminate) after N lines
scenarios.stack_overflow: infinite recursion on the thread that called tblog_init, after N lines
scenarios.stack_overflow_thread: infinite recursion on a second thread (not the tblog_init thread), after it logged N lines
scenarios.kill_hard: 4 threads log; the parent kills the child after a random delay (TerminateProcess / SIGKILL)
scenarios.exit: exit(0) after N lines, without tblog_shutdown / fclose (= return from main)
scenarios._Exit: std::_Exit(0) after N lines: no atexit handlers, no stdio flush

variants.fprintf_buffered: fprintf to one shared FILE* opened "wb", default stdio buffering
variants.tblog: TBLOG_INFO, default config except file only (console=false, reload.watch=false, file.max_size=4GB); full_policy=block (default)
variants.tblog_flush_error: as tblog + flush.on_level=ERROR; every 100th line of each thread is TBLOG_ERROR (same text)
